oncall-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: routing-policy-service crashed repeatedly (policy-engine panic). High error rate on smart-routing/fallback path. Paging oncall.
oncall-bot: severity=sev2 impact=some-customers-502s affected_routes=[/v1/generate], error_rate=28% over 5m, regen_fallback_loop=true
maya (oncall_eng): ack — I'm on it. Paging runtime and platform.
maya (oncall_eng): quick question: is this the new routing expression we pushed last night? saw a config change in prod at 02:12 UTC.
sam (eng-runtime): I see the deploy. Logs show a panic inside policy-evaluator when compiling an expression. Stack trace snippet:
```
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address
at policy/eval/expr.go:214 compileRegex
at policy/eval/evaluator.go:98 Evaluate
```
sam (eng-runtime): suspect invalid regexp in rule `region =~ "us-.*` — missing closing quote/backslash? pulling the exact policy now.
leo (eng-platform): I can roll the policy-service RC back if needed. Also we can flip routing to fallback-to-stable via console toggle: `routing.fallback_mode = "stable"` — that'll bypass policy engine.
maya (oncall_eng): immediate mitigation: switch fallback_mode to stable and scale policy-service replicas to 0 to avoid restarts. Can someone apply via console/terraform? Ops-bot, can you help? @ops-bot
ops-bot: executing: `PATCH /api/v1/configs/routing` -> `{ "fallback_mode":"stable" }` — ok response 202
ops-bot: scaling deployment policy-service to 0 replicas via k8s API: `kubectl scale deploy/policy-service --replicas=0 -n prod` — OK
maya (oncall_eng): good. Error rate down to 3% within 60s. We removed the panic source from the request path.
ashley (sre): I see latency reduction for affected routes but some customers still see 502s from model serving while requests drain. Slackting the top 5 customer IDs in DM for support.
ria (product): which customers were impacted? any enterprise customers with contracts? need to notify if SLA hit.
maya (oncall_eng): impacted_customers: [cust-3492, cust-8841, cust-enterprise-gamma]. cust-enterprise-gamma had ~120 errors during window. Tagging cs/ops for notifications.
sam (eng-runtime): root cause: a malformed expression committed to policy repo: `region =~ "us-*` (missing closing quote). The compiler tries to compile as regex and panics on invalid pattern. We have a validation gap on write. Reproducer locally: pushing same rule causes immediate panic on evaluator init.
sam (eng-runtime): quick patch: detect and sanitize invalid regex at parse-time; fallback to literal match and emit config-validation error. I'll open a PR with tests. For the hotfix path we should reject malformed policies at deploy-time.
leo (eng-platform): short-term mitigation: re-enable strict config-validation job before promoting policy changes. I'm rolling out a gating webhook on the policy repo to run `policy-lint` on PRs. Will push to staging first.
maya (oncall_eng): action items now:
- mitigation done: routing bypassed and policy-service scaled down (maya, ops-bot)
- notify affected customers (ria + cs)
- runtime fix (sam) — PR incoming, aim for rollback-safe patch
- platform gating (leo) — webhook + CI job
- post-incident runbook update (ashley)
maya (oncall_eng): handing off to eng-runtime for the next shift. Sam, can you own the patch verification and coordinate a safe redeploy? I'll be available for 30m then hand to next oncall.
sam (eng-runtime): taking it. Plan: 1) PR to add regex-safety check + unit tests 2) dry-run deploy to canary with policy-service replicas=1 and routing.fallback_mode=stable still on 3) if green, promote and flip fallback_mode back to policy-driven 4) monitor for 10m.
ashley (sre): runbook note: add a pre-flight validation step and a quick rollback command. I'll update the runbook: `kubectl scale deploy/policy-service --replicas=0 -n prod` and console toggle path.
ria (product): I'll draft a short customer message for enterprise-gamma and get signoff from CS lead. ETA 30m.
ops-bot: metrics: error_rate now 0.9%, p95 latency on /v1/generate back to baseline. No more panic events in policy-service logs since scale down.
maya (oncall_eng): handing off: INCIDENT Handoff -> sam (eng-runtime) now owning. Summary: malformed regex in routing rule caused policy-evaluator panic -> routing fallback loop -> customer 502s. Mitigated by toggling fallback_mode and scaling policy-service to 0. Customer impact limited to a small set, no data loss. Next: patch + gated CI.
maya (oncall_eng): tagging oncall-note: severity=sev2, start=1972543210, mitigated=1972543335, assigned_to=sam(eng-runtime). Please create incident ticket CIC-197254 for postmortem.
sam (eng-runtime): created ticket CIC-197254. I will post status updates in this thread. First PR in progress (link: https://git.internal/redwood/policy/PR/412)
maya (oncall_eng): thanks everyone; leaving channel. If anything regresses ping me with @maya.
sam (eng-runtime): received. beginning validation work and canary redeploy in 20m. Will update.
ops-bot: reminder: run `policy-lint` locally: `./tools/policy-lint --check-regex policy.yaml` — returns non-zero for invalid regex.
ashley (sre): after action: add a healthcheck that prevents policy-service from entering restart loop if config parse fails (fail-open vs fail-close decision in runbook).
sam (eng-runtime): noted. Will propose fail-open semantics and a feature flag for stricter parsing in prod.
ops-bot: incident closed for active panic events. Keep thread open for postmortem notes.
maya (oncall_eng): closing my handoff. Good job team.
